description: The OpenAQ Python SDK is the official Python client for interacting with the OpenAQ API. Compatible with Python ≥3.10, it is recommended over hand-written API access code, offering built-in best practices and features including: comprehensive type annotations with inline documentation for better IDE autocomplete; robust API validation with automatic checking of path and query parameters and clear, actionable error messages; deserialized response classes providing Python objects with attribute access, plus JSON and dictionary representation options; and automatic rate-limiting with expressive error handling that gracefully manages API limits.
name: OpenAQ Python SDK
